_note: Chapter 11, Madderby guild house: Ysolde explains the Wide Rift's far end in Ashmere and anchor bonds (plan items 1444, 1456).

say: Ysolde spreads an old file across the table. The paper is brown with age.
Ysolde: The Wide Rift has two ends. This one, and a far end in the ash highlands of Ashmere.
Ysolde: The gravers there engrave maps in copper. Their plates hold a place still, for a hundred years.
Ysolde: And this, for your friend Kestra. Rift-born Spirlings don't need an open Rift.
Ysolde: They need an anchor bond. One person. Tatter has one already.
Ysolde: Take the mountain railway north. Master graver Halvard will help you. Go, apprentice.
